newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: POLL - Portugal seen keeping rates steady Friday.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Portugal seen keeping rates steady Friday.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal was expected to leave key rates steady tomorrow and to wait for June inflation data on Monday before deciding on any changes, according to eight out of 10 analysts polled by Reuters.
They said that the market was not discounting a drop in Portuguese rates but was optimistic about the June inflation rate which is expected to reverse May's higher trend.
All 10 analysts said the central bank had room for rate cuts in the future.
The Bank of Portugal will announce its decision on rates tomorrow for a new commercial bank reserves period which starts on Monday.
The repo rate has stood at 6.00 percent, the draining rate at 5.70 percent and the emergency lending rate at 7.70 percent since May 12.
The following are the results of the poll, conducted today:
1. Will the Bank of Portugal lower the repo rate this week?
No - 8
Yes - 2
2. If the answer to question 1. is yes, by how much will the central bank lower the repo rate ?
By between 20 and 30 basis points.
3. Will the Bank of Portugal lower the draining rate this
week?
No - 8
Yes - 2
4. If the answer to question 3. is yes, by how much will the central bank lower the draining rate ?
By 20 to 30 basis points.
5. Is there still room for further cuts in key rates ?
No - 0
Yes - 10

NOTE: Banks and brokers which took part in the poll included: Banco Portugues de Investimento; IMF-Informacao de Mercados Financeiros; Siemca-Sociedade Mediadora de Capitais; Credit Lyonnais; Banco de Comercio e Industria; Banco Finantia; Banco Mello de Investimentos; Banco Essi.
